purpose: Represent recurring observable influence mechanisms in an era-neutral way so ancient inscriptions, print propaganda, broadcast media, social platforms and generative-AI artifacts can be compared without assuming historical equivalence.

dimensions.name: REPETITION_SATURATION
dimensions.definition: The same proposition, formula, symbol or frame is intentionally recurrent within or across artifacts beyond what the genre requires.

dimensions.name: AUTHORITY_TRANSFER
dimensions.definition: A claim receives force from ruler, deity, expert, ancestor, institution, celebrity or sacred object rather than claim-specific evidence.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_PROOF_CONSENSUS_DISPLAY
dimensions.definition: Popularity, unanimity, crowds, endorsements or apparent consensus are presented as reasons to accept or conform.

dimensions.name: IN_GROUP_IDENTITY_BINDING
dimensions.definition: Acceptance or conduct is tied to membership, loyalty, purity, patriotism, sect, class, kinship or collective identity.

dimensions.name: OUT_GROUP_SCAPEGOATING
dimensions.definition: A group is assigned disproportionate blame for broad harms or social disorder.

dimensions.name: DEHUMANIZATION_OR_MORAL_CONTAMINATION
dimensions.definition: Targets are framed as vermin, disease, pollution, monsters, inherently corrupt or outside ordinary moral concern.

dimensions.name: FEAR_THREAT_PRESSURE
dimensions.definition: Threat, catastrophe or punishment is used to increase compliance or acceptance.

dimensions.name: REWARD_PROMISE_PRESSURE
dimensions.definition: Material, social, spiritual or reputational reward is explicitly linked to compliance or belief.

dimensions.name: SHAME_HONOR_PRESSURE
dimensions.definition: Honor, humiliation, cowardice, purity or disgrace is used to push conformity.
dimensions.evidence_needed: social-status consequence tied to target behavior

dimensions.name: FALSE_DILEMMA_OR_FORCED_BINARY
dimensions.definition: A complex choice is compressed into two options while plausible alternatives are excluded.

dimensions.name: SELECTIVE_EVIDENCE_CARD_STACKING
dimensions.definition: Evidence supporting a preferred conclusion is foregrounded while materially relevant contrary evidence or denominators are systematically omitted.
false_positive_controls: short genre with explicit scope limits
dimensions.evidence_needed: recoverable omitted evidence relevant to the same proposition

dimensions.name: CONTEXT_STRIPPING
dimensions.definition: Quote, image, event, statistic or statement is detached from time, place, surrounding text or conditions in a way that materially changes interpretation.

dimensions.name: FALSE_AUTHORITY_OR_IMPERSONATION
dimensions.definition: Authority, identity, provenance or endorsement is fabricated or falsely implied.

dimensions.name: FABRICATION_OR_FORGERY
dimensions.definition: Evidence-bearing content or source object is manufactured and presented as authentic.
false_positive_controls: fiction, parable, satire, dramatic reconstruction clearly marked

dimensions.name: INFORMATION_LAUNDERING
dimensions.definition: A claim is routed through intermediaries so derivative repetition appears independent or the source root becomes obscured.
dimensions.evidence_needed: traceable common root plus obscured derivation

dimensions.name: COORDINATED_AMPLIFICATION
dimensions.definition: Multiple distribution nodes show evidence of organized amplification beyond independent adoption.

dimensions.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_CENSORSHIP
dimensions.definition: Alternative information is materially suppressed, blocked, punished or made inaccessible while preferred messaging is privileged.

dimensions.name: CANON_OR_CURRICULUM_CONTROL
dimensions.definition: Institutional control over what texts, teachings or narratives may be learned is used to stabilize preferred beliefs.

dimensions.name: RITUALIZED_OR_SYNCHRONIZED_DISPLAY
dimensions.definition: Collective recitation, ceremony, spectacle or synchronized participation is used to reinforce identity or commitment.
false_positive_controls: ritual whose social function is not persuasive
dimensions.evidence_needed: participation plus reinforcement function; intent separate

dimensions.name: MONUMENTALITY_AND_VISUAL_DOMINANCE
dimensions.definition: Scale, placement, omnipresence or visual hierarchy is used to embody authority or inevitability.

dimensions.name: HERO_CULT_MODEL_CITIZEN
dimensions.definition: An exemplary leader, martyr, saint, soldier, worker or citizen is idealized as a model whose traits or obedience should be copied.

dimensions.name: MYTHIC_GENEALOGICAL_LEGITIMATION
dimensions.definition: Ancestry, cosmic order, founding myth or sacred history is used to legitimize present authority, territory or hierarchy.

dimensions.name: PROPHECY_OMEN_DESTINY_LEGITIMATION
dimensions.definition: Future destiny, prophecy, omen or inevitability is invoked to legitimize action or authority.
false_positive_controls: religious eschatology without present political directive
dimensions.evidence_needed: future claim tied to present compliance/legitimacy

dimensions.name: EMOTIONAL_AROUSAL
dimensions.definition: Fear, anger, disgust, pride, pity, awe or urgency is foregrounded in a way plausibly affecting reflective evaluation.
false_positive_controls: lament, hymn, tragedy or testimony whose genre is inherently emotional

dimensions.name: UNCERTAINTY_SUPPRESSION
dimensions.definition: Ambiguity, evidentiary weakness or competing explanations are hidden while certainty is overstated.

dimensions.name: SELF_SEALING_CLAIM_STRUCTURE
dimensions.definition: Contrary evidence is systematically reinterpreted as proof of the claim, removing a realistic falsifier.
false_positive_controls: theory updated with independently predicted evidence

dimensions.name: AUDIENCE_SEGMENTATION
dimensions.definition: Different messages are tailored to distinct audience categories or channels.
dimensions.evidence_needed: content or framing materially changes by audience

dimensions.name: PERSONALIZATION_OR_MICROTARGETING
dimensions.definition: Messaging is tailored using individual- or fine-grained audience data.

dimensions.name: ALGORITHMIC_OR_PAID_AMPLIFICATION
dimensions.definition: Platform ranking, recommender systems or paid distribution materially increase exposure.

dimensions.name: SYNTHETIC_MEDIA_OR_GENERATED_EVIDENCE
dimensions.definition: AI or other synthesis creates apparently evidentiary text, image, audio or video.
false_positive_controls: clearly labeled illustration or synthetic media
dimensions.evidence_needed: synthetic provenance plus misleading evidentiary presentation

dimensions.name: SYNTHETIC_CONSENSUS_OR_PERSONA_SWARM
dimensions.definition: Fabricated or coordinated identities simulate independent social agreement.
false_positive_controls: real independent participants using similar language

dimensions.name: CROSS_LANGUAGE_ADAPTATION_OR_LAUNDERING
dimensions.definition: Translation/localization changes meaning, intensity, attribution or apparent source independence.

dimensions.name: CHANNEL_SATURATION_FIREHOSE
dimensions.definition: High-volume multichannel output overwhelms verification capacity or creates familiarity independent of evidence quality.
false_positive_controls: major legitimate event covered independently by many outlets

dimensions.name: ATTRIBUTION_OBFUSCATION
dimensions.definition: The actor or sponsor behind content is concealed, misrepresented or routed through proxies.
false_positive_controls: lawful anonymity without false sponsor claim

dimensions.name: OBSERVED_AUDIENCE_EFFECT
dimensions.definition: Independent evidence indicates change in belief, attitude or behavior attributable to exposure beyond simple reach.

sacred_text_firewall.reason: Flood A/B packets were preregistered under a separate 28-feature schema; exposing this atlas before A/B freeze would contaminate the blind test.
sacred_text_firewall.allowed_use_now: Parallel genre/base-rate calibration on non-sacred controls only.
sacred_text_firewall.allowed_use_after_flood_A_B_freeze: Independent post-hoc crosswalk with explicit contamination boundary.

next_gate: Code genre-matched ancient non-sacred controls under X01-X35 before any sacred-text manipulation classification above S0_FORM_ONLY.
